title: Chicken provençal with tomatoes, olives and herbs
steps: Cut the chicken into large pieces, season and brown all over in 1 tsp oil, then remove.
Dice the onion, garlic, courgette and pepper and soften in the remaining oil for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, herbs, olives and beans, put the chicken back and braise covered for 15–20 minutes.
